note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Prepare statements run in one PowerShell session with the episode folder as current directory; variables do not survive into the screens, so each screen re-derives what it needs.
prepare: # owner signed in off camera: gh auth login (scopes repo, workflow, read:packages, delete_repo, delete:packages)
gh repo create "$owner/$repo" --public --description "DEVLADLOG Dev Tools #6 demo (throwaway)"

@{ reviewers = @(@{ type = 'User'; id = [int]$uid }); prevent_self_review = $false; deployment_branch_policy = @{ protected_branches = $false; custom_branch_policies = $true } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | gh api -X PUT "repos/$owner/$repo/environments/production" --input -
# (the production environment has the recording account as reviewer and no secrets; the baseline deploy job is rejected)
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\work\ep06 | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\work\ep06\$repo -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
git config user.name 'Alex Demo'; git config user.email 'alex.demo@contoso.com'
# do NOT run scripts/setup-dev.sh here: episode 1 hooks refuse commits on main
git add -A; git commit -m 'chore: import orders api'; git push -u origin main
# owner, now: when deploy shows 'Waiting' in the Actions tab, Review deployments > Reject (no Azure behind it). Check the build-test summary: Coverage product code 80/80
gh run watch (gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId')
git add -A; git commit -m 'feat(orders): export orders as csv'
# not pushed yet: the first screen pushes it
